name: Gerbie

spells.name: Truespeech (Constant)
spells.text:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

---

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

spells.name: Calm (At Will)
spells.text:
You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

Spell Effect: Calm

spells.name: Charm
spells.text:
To the target, your words are honey and your visage seems bathed in a dreamy haze. It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if you or your allies recently threatened it or used hostile actions against it.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends. When the spell ends, the target doesn't necessarily realize it was charmed unless its friendship with you or the actions you convinced it to take clash with its expectations, meaning you could potentially convince the target to continue being your friend via mundane means.

---

Critical Success The target is unaffected and aware you tried to charm it.

Success The target is unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless instead of charm, unless it identifies the spell.

Failure The target's attitude becomes Friendly toward you. If it was Friendly, it becomes Helpful. It can't use hostile actions against you.

Critical Failure The target's attitude becomes Helpful toward you, and it can't use hostile actions against you.

---

Heightened (4th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations.

Heightened (8th) The duration lasts until the next time you make your daily preparations, and you can target up to 10 creatures.

items.name: All My Favorite Things!
items.text:
The gerbie overloads the mind of a creature within 100 feet with thoughts of sunny days, of cute fauna and beautiful flora, of frolicking in fields, and of many other pleasant things. The creature takes 4d6 mental damage and must attempt a DC 21 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and becomes Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes Stunned 1 and stupefied 1 for 1 round.

items.name: Forget Now
items.text: The gerbie attempts a jaws Strike. If the Strike hits, the gerbie affects the creature they just attacked with Make it All Better to make it forget the attack.

items.name: Friendship Aura
items.text:
30 feet. When a creature enters or starts its turn in the gerbie's friendship aura, it attempts a DC 21 Will save save.

Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to this gerbie's friendship aura for 24 hours.

Failure The creature is unable to take hostile actions toward the gerbie until it leaves the aura or until the gerbie targets it with a hostile action.

Critical Failure The creature is unable to take hostile actions toward anyone in the friendship aura until it leaves the aura.

items.name: Make it All Better
items.text: Effect The gerbie touches a creature and causes it to forget something, suppressing all memory of a particular topic, detailed in 50 words or fewer. If the creature is unwilling, it can attempt a DC 21 Will save save to negate the effect. A creature with a memory altered this way can attempt a DC 21 Will save save to regain the original memory each morning.

text:
A lone traveler strays into the woods and stumbles across a circle of mushrooms that tower overhead like trees, each one hollowed out and marked with holes. Numerous pairs of oversized, circular eyes suddenly glow from within the hollows. Within moments, a crowd of small, furry bipeds swarms the wanderer, each resembling a hybrid between a mouse and lizard. And then… the gerbies begin chattering in squeaky, high-pitched voices, bombarding the newcomer with greetings and questions. All welcoming, all smiling, all happy to meet a new friend!

Gerbies live in quaint, communal societies where they craft all their material needs and practice vegetarianism. Knowing that not all places have the privilege of such harmony, gerbies make it their life's purpose to foster peace and friendship wherever they go. Gerbies value empathy and positive communication, and with their natural knack for both, they often appoint themselves as mediators for any conflicts in their vicinity. Conveniently, all it takes is a touch of magical persuasion—and in severe cases, memory modification—to resolve most disputes. Even without their mind-affecting powers, gerbies possess exceptionally pleasant smiles and exude disarming affability.
